steps.title: 01 · Print
steps.body: Open the PDF in your preferred PDF tool. Print it as a booklet, on both sides, flipping on the short edge. Print one copy first to check the pages line up.

steps.title: 02 · Paper
steps.body: Regular printing paper is thick enough. Recycled paper cuts the cost. Black and white is fine.

steps.title: 03 · Fold and staple
steps.body: Fold the stack in half and staple along the fold. A long-arm stapler reaches the middle of the sheet.

steps.title: 04 · Trim
steps.body: If the file has crop marks, cut along them.

shop.title: At a print shop
shop.body: Bring the PDF and ask for an A5 saddle-stitched booklet, printed double sided.

spreadPrint: This PDF contains facing pages. Split the spreads into single pages in your PDF tool before using booklet mode, or give the supplied PDF to a print shop. Print one copy first to check the page order and orientation.
